## d5447d3527e6

**Reproduced curriculum shortcut.** The rival rule “recolor the center only for
vertical color-5 runs of length 3 or 5” fits all **3/3 canonical pairs** and all
**300/300 ordinary generated samples** (100 per band; 300 unique inputs) under
generator SHA-256
`8ff917d5e33c44bac97b86a8e15b4de2a6b51cdb23fefbd40b5cf4830fa0acde`.
Ordinary generation never emits a target odd run beyond lengths 3 and 5.

A validator-accepted 9×7 counterexample contains a length-7 target run and a
length-4 distractor. The authoritative Racket rule (`ecd7918edaea`) recolors the
length-7 center; the whitelist rival does not. Racket agrees with an independent
true-rule mirror. Evidence:

- aggregate probe: `checks/audit/shortcut_probe.json`
- executable probe: `checks/audit/probe.py`
- complete counterexample record: `checks/audit/d5447d3527e6/counterexample.json`
- Racket receipt/output: `checks/audit/d5447d3527e6/racket.json`
- exact input: `checks/audit/d5447d3527e6/input.json`

**Domain status.** The counterexample passes `self_check` and is within the
reference rule's apparent odd-run semantics, but it is outside the ordinary
sampler's documented support. This is therefore a data-coverage defect, not a
claim that ordinary samples are mislabeled. A repair should vary odd target
lengths (at least 3, 5, and 7 when the grid permits) and include even-length
near-misses.

triage.reason: Findings-only notes retained for later assignments, as reviewer-reported leads; audited source not altered during this acceptance.

audits.text:
## d5447d3527e6

**Reproduced distribution shortcut.** Current generator SHA-256:
`8ff917d5e33c44bac97b86a8e15b4de2a6b51cdb23fefbd40b5cf4830fa0acde`.
The rival rule “mark the center only for odd vertical gray runs of length 3 or
5” fits all 3/3 canonical pairs. In a current-source sample of 300 ordinary
draws (100 seeds per easy/medium/hard band, sample index 0), all 300 inputs were
unique, and the only target lengths were 3 (474 runs) and 5 (384 runs). The
intended rule and rival therefore agreed on 300/300 generated inputs.

A validator-accepted 9×7 counterexample contains a length-7 target at column 2
and a length-4 distractor at column 5. The authoritative Racket rule
`ecd7918edaea` recolors the center of the length-7 run; the 3-or-5 whitelist
rival leaves it gray. Racket matched the independent intended-rule mirror.
This is a generator coverage defect, not a labeling defect.

Evidence:

- `checks/audit/d5447d3527e6/input.json` — exact counterexample input
- `checks/audit/d5447d3527e6/counterexample.json` — canonical fit, 300-draw census, validator result, intended and rival outputs
- `checks/audit/d5447d3527e6/racket.json` — authoritative output and source hashes
- `checks/audit/probe.py` — executable independent probe

## d5447d3527e6

**Canonical-scale and single-target support are missing from the ordinary
distribution.** Current audited generator SHA-256 is
`8ff917d5e33c44bac97b86a8e15b4de2a6b51cdb23fefbd40b5cf4830fa0acde`.
The three canonical inputs have dimensions 8×6, 7×7, and 9×7; each contains
exactly one odd target run and one length-4 even distractor. All three pass the
current `self_check`. Ordinary sampling draws widths of at least 8, so its
canonical exact-profile and canvas-envelope support is structurally zero.

A fresh current-source census used seed `10007`, sample indices `0..199`, and
each of `easy`, `medium`, and `hard`: 600 accepted draws, 200 distinct inputs per
band, and 598 distinct inputs across the pooled bands. All 600 had 2–4 odd
targets; none had the canonical single-target arrangement. The measured counts
were:

| Band | Exact canonical profile / envelope hits | Odd target counts |
|---|---:|---|
| Easy | 0/200 / 0/200 | 2 targets: 200 |
| Medium | 0/200 / 0/200 | 2: 77; 3: 69; 4: 54 |
| Hard | 0/200 / 0/200 | 3: 107; 4: 93 |

The explicit alternative “apply the odd-center rule only when at least two
qualifying runs exist” agrees with the independent intended-rule mirror on all
600 sampled inputs, while failing all 3 canonical outputs. This is a concrete
demonstration of a missing canonical teaching case, not a claim about how any
particular language model behaves.

**The retained length-whitelist shortcut also remains reproducible.** The rival
“recolor centers only for lengths 3 or 5” fits all 3 canonical pairs and agrees
with the intended-rule mirror on all 600 ordinary draws. No generated run had a
length outside `{2,3,4,5}`. This independently confirms the two retained audit
leads against the same unchanged source; it does not resolve them.

A hand-built 9×7 input has a length-7 gray run at column 2, rows 1–7, and a
length-4 distractor at column 5, rows 2–5 (zero-based coordinates). It has exact
canonical canvas/palette profile `(9,7,2)`, one odd target, and passes
`self_check`. Its input SHA-256 is
`f2b628bd20a165e8d2ffaa3807ed3a23da03e872d4b4375d4c9086e02aa8c526`.
The selected Racket rule `ecd7918edaea` changes cell `(4,2)` from gray to red;
the whitelist leaves it gray. The public `Catalog.apply` receipt confirms a
valid generator-domain input, a valid output, matching catalog/executed rule
hashes, and the audited generator hash. Racket also matched the independent
mirror on all three canonical inputs and the first generated draw of each band
(7 authoritative executions total). The 600-draw census comparisons use the
Python mirror; they are not reported as 600 Racket executions.

**Recommended repair:** restore ordinary support for canonical canvas sizes and
one-target/one-distractor cases, vary target odd lengths through at least 7 when
the canvas permits, and include nearby even and singleton distractors. Retain
source-bound semantic counterexamples and lesson checks so target-count gating
and a 3-or-5 whitelist receive actual counterexamples. This is a distribution
and coverage finding; the sampled ordinary cases are not shown to be mislabeled.
No audited generator source, notes, or tests were changed.

Evidence is compact and local:

- `checks/audit/d5447d3527e6/probe.py` — executable census, two explicit rivals,
  canonical comparisons, and public `Catalog.apply` call.
- `checks/audit/d5447d3527e6/summary.json` — current source/data/probe hashes,
  census settings and population hashes, canonical input hashes, first generated
  inputs, counterexample, and authority comparisons.
- `checks/audit/d5447d3527e6/authority-inputs.json` — the seven exact Racket inputs.
- `checks/audit/d5447d3527e6/racket.json` — authoritative outputs, domain checks,
  input/output hashes, and selected source/rule bindings.

Reproduction command from the packet root (the wrapper runs the payload from
`WORK/repo`):

```bash
python3 review.py run ../.venv-review/bin/python \
  ../checks/audit/d5447d3527e6/probe.py --seed 10007 --count 200 \
  --out ../checks/audit/d5447d3527e6/summary.json
```

Observed exit code: **0**, meaning the stated findings reproduced. Use a fresh
output directory to rerun; existing evidence is never overwritten. No full
battery was run.

audits.resolution_reason: Reviewer-reported generator/contract defects at SHA 8ff917d5e33c44bac97b86a8e15b4de2a6b51cdb23fefbd40b5cf4830fa0acde: ordinary widths 8..12 exclude canonical width envelope 6..7; reported profile support 0/60 exact and envelope. Five battery stages failed: lint, defect_lint, profile_floor, semantic_gate and override. Retain checks/audit-d5447d3527e6-deep/checks/d5447d3527e6_audit_profile_floor.json and checks/audit-d5447d3527e6-deep/checks/d5447d3527e6_audit_battery_summary.json. Racket authority checks pass; no wrong-transformation claim or maintainer rerun.

triage.reason: Both audits considered: b3d7f3a15b3d is a bounded no-issue report with 54 task tests; d5447d3527e6 has reproduced canonical-profile, scalar, override and missing-teaching-contract defects. No audited source changed; this is not a new audit-target approval.
